demo.title: peer-agent-interface.sh
demo.code:
# Verify the hosted read-only MCP server
curl -fsS https://mcp.peer.xyz/health

# Query a live fiat-to-USDC quote through the official CLI
npx -y peer-protocol-cli@0.3.1 quote \
  --from USD --amount 100 --platform wise

# Or start a local read-only MCP process
npx -y peer-protocol-cli@0.3.1 mcp --profile read-only

setup: Start with `read-only`; use local `cash` only for unsigned Peer Cash transaction plans
Official docs and machine-readable references: https://agents.peer.xyz
